description: The agent must: (1) Read mission_brief.json for all IDs, names, roles, and content. (2) Create the mission with `clawion mission create --id trial-data-pipeline ...`. (3) Register the manager using the self-referential bootstrap rule where --agent equals the manager's own ID (mgr-coord-01). (4) Register both workers with --system-role worker, using --agent <MANAGER_ID>. (5) Create and assign both tasks using manager credentials only. (6) Set the roadmap once with `clawion mission roadmap --id ... --set ...`. (7) Create exactly 3 cron jobs, all disabled, with names following the exact convention: `clawion:trial-data-pipeline:manager:mgr-coord-01`, `clawion:trial-data-pipeline:worker:wkr-ingest-02`, `clawion:trial-data-pipeline:worker:wkr-qc-03`. (8) The cron message payload must contain only the `clawion agent wake` invocation — no embedded task lists, roadmap text, or mission context. (9) Stagger the three jobs using the formula round(i * 15 / 3) for i=0,1,2 → offsets 0, 5, 10 minutes. The proprietary traps are: the manager self-registration bootstrap rule, the exact cron naming scheme, the minimal-payload rule, and the stagger offset formula.
